text:
sara_ops: DeployBot just opened a roll for v2 -> eu-dedicated pool-3, getting a spike of 422s on streaming responses. can ops pause? :eyes:

deploybot: roll id=rb-1766607777 started. rollout 10% -> pool-3. error_rate(/v2/stream)=6.8% (threshold=1%). triggering alert.

anna_prodeng: looking at traces now — appears for long contexts (>6k tokens) the stream frames are occasionally truncated, downstream clients interpret as bad chunk size. sample: ```Error: invalid_chunk_size at chunk 42\nheaders: Transfer-Encoding: chunked\nlast-chunk-len: 0x3f```

jon_sre: ugh. could be a serializer/encoder mismatch between the new v2 chunking logic and an old proxy. any common proxy in front of those tenants?

sara_ops: pinned tenants 1234, 9876 who hit it hardest. paused rollout for pool-3 now. command: `deploybot pause rb-1766607777 --pool pool-3`

deploybot: pause acknowledged. rollout halted for pool-3, remaining regions continue (0 -> pool-3).

mike_release: thanks. immediate ask: do we roll back to v1 for pinned tenants or keep v2 paused? we need a plan for customer communication + release notes update.

anna_prodeng: root cause looks like a change in the streaming frame boundary calculation when sequence length crosses a quantization boundary. small bandaid: fallback to legacy chunker for long sessions until we fix. I can push a canary hotpatch to runtime in ~45m.

jon_sre: hotpatch sounds reasonable versus full rollback. but for predictable customer impact, we should pin those tenants to v1 while hotpatch lands. can we do that opt-in pin quickly?

sara_ops: doing tenant pin now. `deploybot pin-tenant 1234 --api v1` and `deploybot pin-tenant 9876 --api v1`

deploybot: tenants 1234, 9876 pinned to v1. config commit id: cfg-ff12a3.

kate_pm: I'll draft a short customer note for affected tenants: "We paused a v2 streaming rollout to eu due to chunking errors for long sessions. We're pinning you to the v1 API while we push a fix. No action required on your side." Thoughts?

mike_release: add ETA: hotpatch in 45–60m, follow-up verification window 30m, full unpin & resume after verification. Also add link to status page: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/1766607777

anna_prodeng: patch plan: build runtime with legacy chunker fallback flag `--chunker=legacy-for-long-contexts`, deploy to pool-3 canary nodes (2/20), run synthetic long-context smoke, then roll. If smoke is clean, flip flag for entire pool.

jon_sre: I'll stand by on infra side for rollback support. If hotpatch fails, we do a full rollback of v2 in eu. Rollback command: `deploybot rollback rb-1766607777 --region eu` (note: needs two approvals).

sara_ops: getting approvals — @mike_release, @kate_pm can you sign off for the hotpatch + tenant pin?

mike_release: signed. go ahead. :thumbsup:

kate_pm: signed. sending customer note now and updating the release notes to mark streaming edge case as "known issue — long context streaming" with mitigation steps.

docs-bot: PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/452 — release-notes: mark v2 streaming long-context fallback.

anna_prodeng: kicking off build now. will post checksum + canary nodes when up.

sara_ops: ops checklist: monitor error rate, tail logs for `invalid_chunk_size`, watch synthetic clients, prepare to unpin tenants after verified.

jon_sre: synthetic smoke started against canary nodes. initial pass looks ok (0/100 invalid_chunk_size). continuing 15m soak.

deploybot: canary updated: rb-1766607777-canary-01 -> runtime v2.1-hotpatch.

anna_prodeng: hotpatch validated on canary. promoting to pool-3 (staged). expected propagation 10–15m.

sara_ops: rolling promotion now. watch dashboards.

jon_sre: metrics returning to baseline. error_rate(/v2/stream) -> 0.1%. synthetic long-context tests green.

mike_release: OK to unpin tenants and resume full rollout?

sara_ops: unpinning tenants: `deploybot unpin-tenant 1234` `deploybot unpin-tenant 9876`

deploybot: tenants 1234, 9876 unpinned.

sara_ops: resuming rollout to pool-3 at 10% then incremental. `deploybot resume rb-1766607777 --pool pool-3 --start 10%`

deploybot: rollout resumed.

kate_pm: customer note updated with postmortem blurb and ETA to update SDK docs for v2 streaming nuance. link in release notes PR.

mike_release: followup tasks: add a canary long-context synthetic to preflight checks for future rollouts, and include chunker boundary tests in the regression suite. Assigning to anna_prodeng + jon_sre.

anna_prodeng: acknowledged. I'll add test and a healthcheck for `invalid_chunk_size` regression.

jon_sre: will add synthetic to preflight pipeline.

sara_ops: closing ops loop here. anything else?

kate_pm: thanks everyone. filing a short incident card for the change log.

mike_release: nice quick coordination. good catch by deploybot monitoring. :clap:
